title: Stripe 429 retry storm — PaymentReconciliationJob caused rate limit cascade
description: PaymentReconciliationJob triggered at 11:00Z issued 2341 Stripe API calls in parallel with no rate limiting. Stripe returned 429 RateLimitExceeded on all calls. Job immediately retried without backoff, amplifying storm to 8470 req/min (10x Stripe limit). All live payment charges blocked for 6 minutes. Fix: add token-bucket rate limiter (100 req/s) and exponential backoff to StripeGateway.

title: Implement exponential backoff and rate limiting for Stripe API calls
description: StripeGateway has no rate limiting or jitter. Add Resilience4j RateLimiter (100 req/s) and retry with exponential backoff + jitter (base=2s, max=60s, multiplier=2). PaymentReconciliationJob should chunk payments into batches of 50 with 1s delay between batches. Add Stripe API quota dashboard alert at 80% of limit.
